note: Hand-written for the first end-to-end runs of the runner. Normally the planner produces this file (BOOTSTRAP Phase 3). It is a one-step plan, so `runner validate` correctly reports L9/L10 -- a real plan needs an integration step early and at the end.

steps.goal: Implement normalize(text) in src/normalize.py: fold full-width ASCII (U+FF01-U+FF5E) to half-width, fold the ideographic space (U+3000) to a normal space, lowercase ASCII letters only, collapse every run of whitespace to a single space, and strip leading and trailing whitespace. Reject a non-str argument rather than coercing it. Characters outside those rules -- Japanese text in particular -- pass through unchanged.

invariants: idempotent: normalize(normalize(t)) == normalize(t) for every str t
only ASCII letters are case-folded; characters outside U+FF01-U+FF5E and U+3000 are returned unchanged

acceptance.then: the result is exactly '日本語 テスト'
the result is exactly '' rather than a single space
